name: blueprint-architect-plugin
description: Analyze arbitrary technology stacks with evidence-aware compatibility findings and generate PRD-driven project blueprints.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze stack compatibility and generate PRD-driven blueprints.
interface.longDescription: Blueprint Architect explains the product problem, guides material decisions, evaluates every declared architecture edge with capability rules and evidence-aware statuses, and generates the confirmed PRD-derived module and interface tree.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $blueprint-architect to interpret my PRD, evaluate the full declared technology graph, resolve compatibility findings, and generate a PRD-derived blueprint.
